# DocumentDB Kubernetes Operator

> A Kubernetes operator for deploying and managing DocumentDB, a PostgreSQL-based document database with a MongoDB-compatible gateway, using CloudNative-PG.

This index points to released documentation. `/latest/` selects the latest stable operator release; `/dev/` contains unreleased changes and is not a substitute for released installation guidance. The links below remain stable even when this index is read from a development snapshot.

For reproducible deployments, pin the Helm chart version and use its numbered documentation snapshot. Operator/chart releases, DocumentDB engine releases, and the CRD API version are independent. The `/preview/` and `/v1/` documentation directories are page layouts, not release numbers; newer snapshots preserve the older links through redirects.

Read the prerequisites before selecting a Kubernetes platform or image layout. Verify deployment health and database operations before reporting success. Cloud deployment commands can create billable resources; review their setup and cleanup instructions before execution.

## Start here

- [Released documentation](https://documentdb.io/documentdb-kubernetes-operator/latest/): Overview and navigation for the latest stable release.
- [Prerequisites and version compatibility](https://documentdb.io/documentdb-kubernetes-operator/latest/preview/getting-started/before-you-start/): Required tools, Kubernetes/runtime requirements, image layouts, and operator versus engine versions.
- [Local Kind quickstart](https://documentdb.io/documentdb-kubernetes-operator/latest/preview/getting-started/quickstart-kind/): Install the released operator and deploy a local DocumentDB cluster.
- [Connecting to DocumentDB](https://documentdb.io/documentdb-kubernetes-operator/latest/preview/getting-started/connecting-to-documentdb/): Credentials, connectivity, and MongoDB-compatible clients.

## Configuration and operations

- [Architecture](https://documentdb.io/documentdb-kubernetes-operator/latest/preview/architecture/overview/): Operator, gateway, and PostgreSQL responsibilities.
- [TLS configuration](https://documentdb.io/documentdb-kubernetes-operator/latest/preview/configuration/tls/): Certificate and encrypted-connection configuration.
- [Upgrades](https://documentdb.io/documentdb-kubernetes-operator/latest/preview/operations/upgrades/): Operator and engine upgrade procedures, including schema migration.
- [Backup and restore](https://documentdb.io/documentdb-kubernetes-operator/latest/preview/operations/backup-and-restore/): Backup configuration and recovery procedures.
- [API reference](https://documentdb.io/documentdb-kubernetes-operator/latest/preview/api-reference/): DocumentDB Kubernetes resource fields.
- [FAQ](https://documentdb.io/documentdb-kubernetes-operator/latest/preview/faq/): Common questions and troubleshooting.

## Optional

- [GitHub releases](https://github.com/documentdb/documentdb-kubernetes-operator/releases): Published operator/chart releases and release notes.
- [Repository](https://github.com/documentdb/documentdb-kubernetes-operator): Source, playgrounds, contribution guidance, and issue tracking; `main` can contain unreleased changes.
